_about: Per-user mainframe settings. Copy this file to 'mainframe.config.json' in the same folder and fill in your own values. 'mainframe.config.json' is listed in .gitignore, so it stays on your machine and is never committed. boot.ps1 reads bitwardenEmail when the Bitwarden CLI needs a login; the MAINFRAME_BW_EMAIL environment variable overrides it. ntfyTopic configures phone approval push notifications for vault unlock during restores; the MAINFRAME_NTFY_TOPIC environment variable overrides it. vaultTtlMinutes defines the local vault session key TTL in minutes (default 60); expired sessions auto-lock and re-prompt for 1-tap mobile approval.
